caption: The drawing shows a single ornate teapot positioned in profile, with its spout on the left and handle on the right. The body of the teapot is round and features elaborate, symmetrical decorative patterns rendered with detailed shading and lines. The spout is long and curves outward, and the lid is topped with a small knob. The handle is large, curving upward and outward, and is shaded in a darker tone, suggesting a different material, possibly wood, compared to the more metallic appearance of the rest of the teapot. The composition is centered on a plain background, with faint horizontal lines indicating a surface under the teapot. The artist's signature "STANIS" appears to the right of the object. The drawing is executed in graphite pencil with the handle accented in a brownish color. The overall color palette is grayscale with the brown accent on the handle.
title: Silver Teapot
